ns2:course.label: Professional Practicum
ns2:course.description: Internship or equivalent experience as it relates to the student's field of study. Student will complete a comprehensive written report, develop a website, and/or give an oral presentation that relates to his/her internship experience. 1 to 8 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 8 hours.
